plan.notes: Transcribed from the official CRC 'Digital Media A.A. Degree - Local GE' program map, Catalog Year 2026-2027, published September 24, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7910/PublishedPdf). GE Pattern: CRC Local GE. Map states Total Units 60-62; lower bound 60 used = 15+15+15+15 (semester sums verified at lower bounds: Sem 1 Area L2 3-4 -> 3; Sem 4 Area L7B 2-3 -> 2). Linked 'select the course not taken' pairs: RTVF 300/PHOTO 302 (Sem 1 takes one, Sem 2 takes the other); RTVF 330/RTVF 319 (Sem 1 takes one, Sem 3 takes the other — the printed footnote 'select course not taken in Semester 2' sits with the 360/362 pair, which previously appeared in Semester 2); RTVF 360/RTVF 362 (Sem 2 takes one, Sem 3 takes the other). RTVF 300 is also listed as JOUR 310; RTVF 330 and RTVF 319 are also listed as JOUR courses per map footnotes. List A (minimum 3 units): RTVF 350 (requires RTVF 330), RTVF 354 (advisory RTVF 362), RTVF 361 (requires RTVF 360), RTVF 365 (requires RTVF 362), RTVF 370, RTVF 371 (1 unit; requires RTVF 330 or 331), RTVF 498 (0.5-4 units) — one 3-unit selection sequenced in each of Semesters 3 and 4; a different course per slot. This program also meets the requirement for the Certificate of Achievement in Digital Media. Advisories are recommendations only, recorded in choice_notes, never as prereqs.
